title: Hannah Blair Salzman: Roguelikes, Neurodiversity, and Mental Illness
speaker: Hannah Blair Salzman
description:
As an autistic adult with adhd, I've struggled to keep interest in games in a way that I didn't when I was younger. My mental health mixed with the increasing amount of time games demand of their players often makes it difficult for me to get invested in video games, but roguelikes are a different story. I would like to explore this, and tell the game devs in the audience about how their game design is helping people like me enjoy games more.

Lead-in music generated by Sonat Uzun.
